facts.claim: Hard paywalls reach a 10.7% median day-35 download-to-paid conversion against 2.1% for freemium
facts.excerpt: median of 10.7% for apps with hard paywalls versus 2.1% in freemium apps for Day 35 download-to-paid

facts.claim: A weekly plan with a trial is the highest-LTV paywall configuration at 49.27 dollars over twelve months
facts.excerpt: Weekly+trial is the highest-LTV paywall configuration at $49.27 over 12 months.

facts.claim: In a survey of 200 B2B software products, one in four freemium products converts under 2.5% of free users within six months, and another quarter reaches 10% to 15%
facts.excerpt: One-in-four freemium products convert less than 2.5% of free users within six months, while another quarter manages 10-15%.

facts.claim: Apple and Google both charge 15% on the first 1 million dollars of annual revenue and 30% above it, plus a 99 dollar and 25 dollar developer fee
facts.source_title: The 15% App Store Fee: A Guide for Developers
facts.excerpt: Apple App Store costs $99/year plus 15% for revenue under $1M/year, 30% above. Google Play charges $25 once plus 15% on first $1M/year, 30% above.

facts.claim: iOS earns roughly twice the ARPU of Android on the same app
facts.excerpt: iOS pays about 2x the ARPU compared to Android.

facts.claim: From 1 January 2026 Apple replaced the per-install Core Technology Fee with a 5% Core Technology Commission on digital-goods revenue
facts.source_title: App Store Fees and Commission Rates in 2026
facts.excerpt: From January 1, 2026, Apple replaced the per-install Core Technology Fee with a 5% Core Technology Commission on digital-goods revenue.
